LAW AND MOTION 301, PLAINTIFF BANK OF NEW YORK'S MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS GRANTED. NO OPPOSITION FILED. THE COURT ALLOWED DISCUSSION AND CLARIFICATION OF A LETTER THAT WAS SUBMITTED IN OPEN COURT BY THE DEFENDANT. AFTER THE COURT REVIEWED THE LETTER AND A DECLARATION SUBMITTED WITH THE PAPERS BY THE PLAINTIFF, THE COURT AFFIRMED ITS TENTATIVE RULING. PREVAILING PARTY TO SUBMIT FORM OF ORDER.
